title: Pottery workbench
passage:
A. The wooden strip reaches from the open bowl to the overturned bowl.
B. One end of the wooden strip dips down into the open bowl.
C. The wooden strip lies flat on the bench between the two bowls.
D. The wooden strip extends past both sides of the open bowl.
passageZh:
A. 木條從開口朝上的碗延伸到倒扣的碗。
B. 木條有一端斜伸進開口朝上的碗裡。
C. 木條平放在兩個碗之間的工作檯上。
D. 木條的兩端都伸出開口朝上的碗的兩側。
